newsitem.title: USA: Cali Realty plans 10 mln share equity offer.
newsitem.headline: Cali Realty plans 10 mln share equity offer.

text.p: Cali Realty Corp said on Tuesday it would begin a public equity offering on Wednesday of 10 million shares of common stock.
The company said in a statement it would use the net proceeds from the offering to reduce outstanding borrowings under its revolving credit facilities.

They include borrowings anticipated in connection with the $282.4 million purchase of Harborside Financial Center in Jersey City, N.J., and to acquire more than 730,000 square feet of additional properties.
The underwriting team, led by Prudential Securities Inc, includes Dean Witter Reynolds Inc; Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp; Morgan Stanley & Co Inc; and Smith Barney Inc.
